originalTitle: Should You Buy The Dip In Datadog Stock?

content:

Datadog (DDOG) stock has fallen 38.8% in a month, while the S&P 500 lost 3.3%. The shares fell hardest on November 4, when Datadog said its largest customer had cut its usage. Datadog had already told investors about that cut in August. A drop this fast invites buyers, though buying pays only if that cut stays with one customer and Datadog keeps turning its sales into cash. Once its largest customer is set aside, are Datadog’s sales still growing?

Outside Its Largest Customer, Datadog’s Growth Sped Up

Yes, so far. Management said on the November 4 call that revenue growth excluding the largest customer accelerated again in fiscal Q3 2026, and that growth from customers outside AI also sped up for the fifth straight quarter. Total revenue in the quarter rose 35.2% from a year earlier.

The slowdown is in the forecast. Datadog expects fourth-quarter revenue to grow 25 to 26% from a year earlier, and that forecast counts the largest customer only at its minimum commitment. Without that customer, management put the growth implied in its forecast in the low to mid-30s percent range. That range alone does not show whether that growth is still speeding up.

Management named one other short-term drag: several large customers renewed early, at higher commitments but with volume discounts. Even so, Datadog raised its fiscal 2026 revenue forecast to $4.52 billion at the midpoint, from $4.46 billion in August.

What Followed Datadog Stock’s One Earlier Drop Of 40%?

Since September 2019, Datadog stock has fallen more than 40% within 30 trading days only once, in the run to May 18, 2022. A buyer on that date was 5.0% ahead a year later. That fall came while the S&P 500 fund (SPY) lost 13.0% over the same days, meaning the whole market was sliding. This time, the drop is Datadog’s own.

Datadog Is Turning Less Of Its Sales Into Cash

Cash from operations came to 34.3% of Datadog’s revenue in fiscal Q4 2025, before dipping to 33.2% in fiscal Q1 2026. It fell again to 28.2% in fiscal Q2 and 24.2% in fiscal Q3. The dollar amount still rose, reaching $290 million in fiscal Q3 from $251 million a year earlier. Datadog also holds more cash than debt, finishing September with $5.23 billion in cash and short-term investments against $1.31 billion of debt.

Buyers pay 15.1 times sales for Datadog stock, compared with 3.1 times for the S&P 500. At that price, they are paying for growth more than for today’s profit: Datadog’s reported operating margin over the last twelve months was 2.3%, against 19.0% for the S&P 500.

What Is A Datadog Buyer Betting On Now?

A buyer today is betting that Datadog keeps growing faster outside its largest customer, as management says it did in fiscal Q3. The cash side is weaker, with the share of revenue kept as operating cash lower in each quarter of fiscal 2026. The one earlier drop of more than 40% left a buyer ahead a year later, but only after a further fall along the way . The share of revenue Datadog keeps as operating cash is the figure to watch in its fiscal Q4 2026 report.

chineseTitle: 你应该买入 Datadog 股票的下跌吗？

chineseContent:
如果对本文或基础研究有疑问，请发送电子邮件至 help@trefis.com。

Datadog (DDOG) 股价一个月内下跌 38.8%，而标准普尔 500 指数下跌 3.3%。 11 月 4 日，该公司股价跌幅最大，当时 Datadog 表示其最大客户已削减其使用量。 Datadog 已于 8 月份向投资者告知了此次削减。如此快速的降价会吸引买家，但只有当降价属于一位客户且 Datadog 不断将其销售额转化为现金时，购买才有回报。一旦最大客户被搁置，Datadog 的销售额还会增长吗？

除了最大客户之外，Datadog 的增长速度加快

是的，到目前为止。管理层在 11 月 4 日的电话会议上表示，2026 财年第三季度（不包括最大客户）的收入增长再次加速，人工智能以外客户的增长也连续第五个季度加速。该季度总收入同比增长 35.2%。

经济放缓已在预测之内。 Datadog 预计第四季度收入将比上年同期增长 25% 至 26%，并且该预测仅按其最低承诺计算最大客户。如果没有该客户，管理层将其预测中隐含的增长幅度定在 30% 到 30% 的中低范围内。仅这个范围并不能表明增长是否仍在加速。

管理层指出了另一个短期阻力：几个大客户提前续约，承诺金额更高，但数量折扣。即便如此，Datadog 将 2026 财年收入预测从 8 月份的 44.6 亿美元上调至中值 45.2 亿美元。

Datadog 股价早些时候下跌 40% 后发生了什么？

自 2019 年 9 月以来，Datadog 股票仅在截至 2022 年 5 月 18 日的 30 个交易日内下跌超过 40%。一年后，该日期的买家领先 5.0%。那次下跌发生时，标准普尔 500 指数基金 (SPY) 在同一天内下跌了 13.0%，这意味着整个市场正在下滑。这一次，掉落的是 Datadog 自己的。

Datadog 正在将较少的销售额转化为现金

2025 财年第四季度，运营现金占 Datadog 收入的 34.3%，然后在 2026 财年第一季度下降至 33.2%。第二财季和第三财季再次下降至 28.2% 和 24.2%。第三财季的美元金额仍然上升，从去年同期的 2.51 亿美元增至 2.9 亿美元。 Datadog 持有的现金也多于债务，截至 9 月份，其现金和短期投资为 52.3 亿美元，债务为 13.1 亿美元。

买家为 Datadog 股票支付的价格为销售额的 15.1 倍，而标准普尔 500 指数为 3.1 倍。按照这个价格，他们为增长付出的代价超过了今天的利润：Datadog 在过去 12 个月报告的营业利润率为 2.3%，而标准普尔 500 指数为 19.0%。

Datadog 买家现在押注什么？

今天，一位买家押注 Datadog 在其最大客户之外将继续保持更快的增长，正如管理层所说的那样，它在第三财季就是这么做的。现金方面较弱，2026 财年每个季度营业现金所占收入份额均较低。早些时候的一次下跌超过 40%，一年后让买家领先，但在此过程中进一步下跌。 Datadog 作为运营现金保留的收入份额是其 2026 年第四季度财报中值得关注的数字。
